description: Energy Communities is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset contains detailed information about the active energy communities in mainland Portugal. It is made up of the following elements: date, year, month, parish (freguesia), type of collective (ACC or CER), and the number of records. The data is obtained through E-REDES's internal sources that monitor the formation and development of energy communities. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Renewables. Its keywords are homepage. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
